text: I feel a sense of curiosity stirring within me. The glass doors and clean lines invite me into a space that seems dedicated to possibility and new ideas. Entering further, I encounter vibrant colors and the promise of discovery in the "R + D" exhibit—research and development, a tribute to innovation. Here, I am witness to humanity's endless desire to understand, to improve, to connect. This environment sharpens my philosophical awareness of progress—how we are always in motion, collectively seeking answers, always reaching forward.
